blocks.text: ONE CLARIFICATION. HIS MEMOIRS SAY KGB. AMERICAN SPECIALISTS SAY GRU, MILITARY INTELLIGENCE.
AND THE PURGES?|HOW DID HE|ESCAPE THEM?
FOR THE MAN THEY SEND, WHAT'S THE DIFFERENCE? A PAWN DOESN'T CHOOSE HIS EMPLOYER.
A MAN WHO SURVIVED THE PURGES LEARNS TO KEEP QUIET. THE FIRST QUALITY OF AN ILLEGAL.
IN “THE AMERICANS”, THEY EVEN HAVE KIDS WHO GO TO CHURCH AND PLAY HOCKEY. REAL YANKEES.
TUOMI DIDN'T NEED TO PLAY THE YANKEE, MADEMOISELLE. HE WAS ONE.
ABOVE ALL, HE HAD ONE THING: TIME. YEARS TO LEARN TO BECOME AGAIN WHAT HE ALREADY WAS.
